messages:
Nora: Quick sync on recurring incidents — compiling action items. Recent pattern: scale-down races + cache thrash + model-swap rollbacks. Need clear owners and one-line actions for the recurrence board.

Luca: I can take scale-down races. Short fix: bump graceful window 30s->100s for warm pools and disable aggressive downscale during backups. Rollout: canary -> 24h -> full. ETA: 2026-04-04.

Dia: I'll own cache thrash. Short fix: enable hot-prefix caching + cap batch-size at ingress. Rollout: feature-flagged region canary then global. ETA: 2026-04-12.

Mateo: I'll handle model-swap rollbacks. Short fix: add tokenization preflight and binary checksum check in swap pipeline; block swap on mismatch. ETA: 2026-04-20.

ops-bot: ticket created #INC-2026-1302 "Recurrence: cache thrash" linked to thread

Nora: Please post one-line items in the format "owner | action | ETA" so I can import to the board. Also paste short oncall mitigation steps (3 bullets max).

Luca: "Luca | bump graceful window + backup gating | 2026-04-04"

Dia: "Dia | enable hot-prefix cache + batch-size cap | 2026-04-12"

Mateo: "Mateo | add tokenization preflight + checksum | 2026-04-20"

Dia: Cache playbook (3 steps): 1) enable read-only cache mode 2) flip hot-prefix flag 3) scale cache nodes for region.

Luca: Scale-down playbook (3 steps): 1) increase graceful window 2) disable downscale during backups 3) failover to warm pool.

Mateo: Model-swap playbook (3 steps): 1) revert model variant 2) run tokenization sample 3) block further swaps and notify model-onboarding.

Nora: Thanks — I'll import these to the recurrence board and schedule a 1-week follow-up to review canary metrics. If anyone gets overloaded, ping me or Mateo to reassign. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
